name: Bane Murrain
storyline: Dayne Muren, a nervous wreck of an engineer working on the K.R.E.V research station, is thrown into the midst of a biohazard bloodbath when a meteorite collision turns his crewmembers into mutated creatures. Armed with an arsenal of weapons and with the help of some trusted companions, it's time for Dayne to uncover the truth behind his initial voyage and maybe find a way back home.
